title: The plus construction is separated and injects into its double plus
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Call a presheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $\mathcal C$ *separated* if for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ the map $\mathcal G(U)\to\prod_i\mathcal G(U_i)$, $s\mapsto(s|_{U_i})_i$, is injective (Stacks Sites, Definition 00WA). For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ let $\mathcal G^+$, $\mathcal G^+(U)=\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal J_U^{opp}}H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal G)$ (the colimit over the coverings of $U$ and their refinements of the zeroth Cech sets $H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal G)=\{(s_i)\in\prod_i\mathcal G(U_i)\mid s_i|_{U_i\times_UU_j}=s_j|_{U_i\times_UU_j}\}$), be its plus construction and $\theta_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G^+$, $s\mapsto[\{\mathrm{id}_U\},s]$, the canonical map [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]; $\mathcal G^+$ is a presheaf and $\theta_{\mathcal G}$ a morphism of presheaves [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal F^{++}=(\mathcal F^+)^+$. Then (1) $\mathcal F^+$ is separated: if $s,s'\in\mathcal F^+(U)$ and $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ is a covering with $s|_{U_i}=s'|_{U_i}$ for all $i$, then $s=s'$; and (2) the canonical map $\theta_{\mathcal F^+}:\mathcal F^+\to\mathcal F^{++}$ is injective, i.e. $\theta_{\mathcal F^+,U}:\mathcal F^+(U)\to\mathcal F^{++}(U)$ is injective for every object $U$.

lean.statement: theorem plus_separated_and_injective {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition] [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks] (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max u w)) : (∀ (U : C) (E : Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.{max u w} J U) (s s' : (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).obj (op U)), (∀ i : E.toPreZeroHypercover.I₀, (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).map (E.toPreZeroHypercover.f i).op s = (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).map (E.toPreZeroHypercover.f i).op s') → s = s') ∧ (∀ (U : C), Function.Injective ((J.toGrothendieck.toPlus (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P)).app (op U)))
lean.note: Uses the recorded small Precoverage site and generated-topology plus construction. The first conjunct tests separatedness on indexed covering families; the second is objectwise injectivity of toPlus applied to plusObj P, from P-plus to P-double-plus. SmallCategory provides the required Type-valued limits and colimits without additional hypotheses.
